info.title: GATEWAY-apiwizruntimedoc-List Weather Alerts Regions-v3-spec
info.description: The Weather Alerts Regions API provides users with access to a comprehensive list of regions where weather alerts are in effect. This API enables developers to retrieve vital information on current weather alerts across various geographical areas, assisting them in making informed decisions based on weather-related hazards. Typical consumers of this API include application developers, emergency service providers, and any organization needing to integrate real-time weather alert information into their systems. The API facilitates seamless access to regional weather alert data, enhancing user awareness and response to weather conditions.

get.description: This endpoint allows clients to fetch alerts that are relevant to a specific region. It enables users to gain insights into alerts based on geographical context.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to specify parameters for retrieving alert information for a specific region. It expects a JSON object conforming to the defined schema.

200.description: Successfully retrieved alerts for the specified region.
